edit.description: defaultLaneFiles — the lane rule spelled a second time
the agreement pin, beside the existing setupFiles one

summary: Judge the spawn-budget scan's default-lane rule against vitest.config.ts's declared globs instead of restating them

per.section: Derived state is computed, never restated beside its source

acceptance: A change to the default lane's declared include/exclude reds this suite instead of silently narrowing what the scan judges.
pins: the spawn-budget scan's lane rule agrees with the default lane vitest.config.ts declares
notes: vitest.config.ts:15-20 declares the lane; spawnBudget.ts:25,78-80 spells it again, and a config-side widening leaves the scan green over sites it no longer reads. The same suite already drives setupFiles config-first (subprocessHelper.test.ts:225). matchesAny cannot evaluate `tests/**/*.test.ts` (`**/` does not collapse), so judge the rule against the declared globs rather than re-globbing the tree.
